recovery.404.title: Page not found
recovery.404.message: The page you’re looking for may have moved or is no longer available.
recovery.404.guidance: Check the address, return to the home page, or resume an application in progress.
recovery.500.title: Something went wrong
recovery.500.message: We’re unable to load this page right now.
recovery.500.guidance: Resume your application to continue from your last saved progress.
recovery.session-expired.title: Your session has timed out
recovery.session-expired.message: Your session has expired due to inactivity.
recovery.session-expired.guidance: Resume from your last saved progress or start a new application. Your most recent unsaved changes may not be available.
recovery.technical-error.title: We ran into an issue
recovery.technical-error.guidance: Resume your application to continue from your last saved progress.
recovery.maintenance.title: We’ll be back soon
recovery.maintenance.message: This site is temporarily unavailable while we perform maintenance.
recovery.maintenance.guidance: Please try again later. If you have an application in progress, resume it when the site is available.
recovery.application-unavailable.title: Application unavailable
recovery.application-unavailable.message: We ran into a technical issue when trying to resume your application.
recovery.application-unavailable.guidanc: Please try again or contact the administrator for help.
recovery.outcome-unknown.title: We ran into an issue
recovery.outcome-unknown.message: The result of this payment or submission has not been confirmed.
recovery.outcome-unknown.guidance: Please don’t submit it again or start a new application. Contact the administrator for help confirming the result.
recovery.validation.title: Check your answers
recovery.validation.message: Please correct the errors below before continuing.
recovery.offline.title: You’re offline
recovery.offline.message: Any changes you make may not be saved.
recovery.save-failed.title: Progress could not be saved
recovery.save-failed.message: We couldn’t save your latest changes.
recovery.save-failed.guidance: Keep your answers on this page and try saving again before continuing.
recovery.save-conflict.title: A newer version is available
recovery.save-conflict.message: A newer version of this application has been saved.
recovery.save-conflict.guidance: Keep this page open and contact the administrator before replacing either version.
recovery.processing-pending.title: Working on your application
recovery.processing-pending.message: Please wait while this step completes.
recovery.processing-timeout.title: This step is taking longer than expected
recovery.processing-timeout.message: We couldn’t confirm that this step completed.
recovery.processing-timeout.guidance: Your form has not been cleared. Resume your application or contact the administrator for help.
recovery.processing-complete.title: This step is complete
recovery.processing-complete.message: You can continue with your application.
recovery.payment.guidance: Return to Payment and try again, or contact the administrator for help.
recovery.submission.guidance: Return to Payment and try submitting your application again, or contact the administrator for help.
recovery.operation.unknown: We can’t confirm the result of your {{operation}} yet.
recovery.page.failed: We couldn’t load the next page of your application.
